fields.speakerBio: 汤庸，学者网创始人，国家教学名师（“万人计划”领军人才），国务院特殊津贴专家，教育部新世纪优秀人才，国际人工智能科学院会士（AIIS Fellow），华南师范大学首批二级教授；教育部数据科学课程群虚拟教研室负责人，琶洲实验室杰出科学家，广东科技学院学术副校长。专注学者社交网络及数据智能，获广东省科学技术一等奖、教育部科技进步二等奖、国家教学成果二等奖、宝钢教育奖、丁颖科技奖、教育部-华为智能基座优秀教师、CCF协同计算杰出贡献奖等。 汤庸教授曾任中国计算机学会理事、协同计算专委会主任、YOCSEF广州创始主席、ACM广州分会主席、广东省计算机学会常务副理事长；担任多类国家级人才及重点项目会评专家，多个重要学术会议主席和大会报告人，包括CCF推荐会议；在140多所高校作特邀报告，包括39所985高校及海外高校。主持国家重点和省重大项10多项；出版中英文著作20余部，发表CCF A/B和SCI一/二区论文100多篇。

fields.title: Nanosphere Lithography: Technology and Applications
fields.topic: “中外研思，启鉴新知”国际交流板块之海外学术与文化经验分享会
fields.speaker: Eser Metin Akinoglu
fields.location: 华南师范大学大学城校园环学院5报告厅
fields.abstract: Nanosphere lithography (NSL) is a cost-effective and versatile nanofabrication method that employs self-assembled monolayers of monodispersive nanoparticles, which are often referred to as artificial 2D opals, as templates for pattern transfer. Among various fabrication techniques, the interface assembly method yields the most uniform monolayers with minimal defect density. These colloidal monolayers feature periodic triangular voids that serve as deposition masks, enabling the creation of a wide variety of nanostructures through electron beam evaporation and subsequent template removal. Template modification via oxygen plasma etching allows fine-tuning of particle dimensions, leading to expanded structural diversity such as nanorings, split rings, and filled cups. The optical and plasmonic properties of these nanostructures arise from localized and propagating surface plasmon modes, which can be tailored through geometry, periodicity, and material choice. The presentation also discusses the transition from particle-based to hole-based arrays, the role of percolation effects, and the design of transparent conductors derived from metallic nanomeshes. Although such nanostructured electrodes exhibit promising optical transparency, their sheet resistance remains higher than that of conventional indium tin oxide (ITO). Finally, vertically coupled plasmonic pillar arrays are shown to offer tunable infrared resonances, with potential applications in sensing and infrared photonics. This work demonstrates how nanosphere lithography bridges the gap between low-cost colloidal self-assembly and high-performance nanophotonic device fabrication, offering a scalable route to structured materials for plasmonics, optoelectronics, and energy conversion.
fields.speakerBio: Eser Metin Akinoglu ' research primarily focuses on the interaction between light and matter in nanomaterials, the preparation of micro/nano-materials, and their applications in electrochemistry. Having been granted the Feodor Lynen Fellowship by the Humboldt Foundation, he obtained his Ph.D. from the Free University of Berlin. His doctoral research centered on nanostructured electrodes designed for renewable energy. During his doctoral studies, he delved into the properties of metal, semiconductor, and carbon-based nanomaterials, with a particular emphasis on the structural, plasmonic, and excitonic characteristics of multi-walled carbon nanotubes. Additionally, he conducted research at the Helmholtz-Zentrum Berlin and collaborated with Professor Markus Antonietti at the Max Planck Institute for Colloids and Interfaces in Potsdam. After completing his doctorate, Dr. Akinoglu became a member of Guangdong's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Team at Jinan University (Zhaoqing), where he worked closely with Professors Michael Giersig and Paul Mulwa. Throughout his academic career, he has been the recipient of numerous honors and has co-authored several papers and patents.

fields.title: 对音乐理论建构中国自主知识体系的若干思考
fields.speaker: 黄宗权
fields.abstract: 构建中国音乐理论的自主知识体系，既是时代命题，也是中国音乐理论经过百余年积累后进入理论反思与范式重构的必然要求。本讲座回顾了从西方音乐中心的转变，以及西方音乐学术话语的历史和现状，批判性审视了新音乐学及后现代话语对音乐本体问题的错位，指出西方理论在解释中国音乐经验时存在的问题。在建构路径上，讲座提出学理思考：以中国音乐的本体经验和理论为基础，着力构建主体性方法论体系——确立“经验、概念、理论”的学术生成机制，建立术语学与概念史研究、推进形态学与美学再建构等。讲座也提出避免“为自主而自主”，防止狭隘民族主义与学术泛政治化，应在开放、自信的对话中，产出具有中国立场和世界意义的原创理论。
fields.speakerBio: 黄宗权，中央音乐学院教授，博士生导师。中国评协理事、中国音乐美学会理事、中国音乐评论学会理事、中国西方音乐学会理事，CAAI艺术与人工智能专委会委员，CCF计算艺术分会执委，北京市文联签约评论家，北京市评协舞台艺术专业委员会委员。《中国艺术发展报告》撰稿人，《北京市文艺发展报告（音乐卷）》负责人。在《音乐周报》《音乐爱好者》等刊物开设个人专栏。主要研究方向：音乐美学(哲学)、音乐社会学、西方音乐史学，兼涉音乐评论写作。出版专著《音乐美感的属性》、论文《音乐人工智能的哲学审视》，参与国家社科基金重大项目《音乐与人工智能协同创新发展理论研究》等课题研究。国家社科基金重大招标项目《音乐创作“中国性”研究》子课题负责人。主持国家社科基金金项《朱熹音乐美学思想研究》。

fields.abstract: 陈妨老师围绕“自然教育：从丹霞山世界地质公园，走向青年成长”作专题讲座，结合丹霞山世界地质公园自然教育实践，系统讲解自然保护地如何转化为“没有围墙的学校”、自然教育如何赋能青年成长，分享科普导师服务体系构建经验，回应研究生在自然教育、研学旅行、生态文明建设方向的学术困惑。
